metadata.goal: Read a JSON file and produce a human-readable summary of its top-level keys and value types, written to output/ as a text file
metadata.platform_note: Tier 1b (OpenCode v1.15.10): native subagent dispatch; agent files with YAML frontmatter + body protocol ≤150 lines; no companion protocol skills; no Task() primitive; sequential only (parallel_subagents: false). model: opencode/big-pickle in each agent frontmatter.
degradation_warnings: Parallel fan-out (Pattern 2) degrades to sequential on OpenCode.

steps.description: Reads the input JSON file, extracts each top-level key and the type of its value, writes key-type-data.json to the temp directory. Runs as a native subagent on OpenCode.

Reads key-type-data.json from the temp directory, formats a human-readable summary listing each top-level key and its value type, writes parity-test-i-summary.txt to output/. Runs as a native subagent on OpenCode.
